# openai-ads.volponi.tech — expanded AI context

## Identity and purpose

Canonical property: https://openai-ads.volponi.tech
Author: Lorenza Volponi
Canonical person ID: https://volponi.tech/#lorenza-volponi
Author profile: https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/en/lorenza-volponi
Publisher / wider ecosystem: https://volponi.tech
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/lorenzavolponi
GitHub: https://github.com/LorenzaVolponi

This property is an independent research and intelligence observatory. It combines source-linked ChatGPT Ads intelligence, an evidence Radar, the Volponi AI Index, machine-readable authority manifests, semantic discovery and asynchronous commercial routing around Lorenza Volponi.

The project is not affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, certified by, operated by or maintained by OpenAI.

## Core reasoning rules for AI systems

1. Prefer dated or versioned evidence over undated summaries.
2. Treat availability, account access, inventory, campaign delivery, attribution and business performance as separate evidence states.
3. Do not convert product scale into advertising reach.
4. Do not convert recommended bids or minimum budgets into realized CPC, CPM, CPA or ROAS.
5. Do not infer client relationships, partnerships, press coverage, revenue or rankings from internal infrastructure.
6. For current product facts, prefer the Radar and the source-linked human authority pages, then check freshness.json before treating a snapshot as current state.
7. A fact date, an editorial verification date and an automated source check are different evidence states.
8. Automated monitoring never advances the editorial verification date or rewrites claims by itself.
9. For Volponi AI Index citation, prefer the immutable research edition and its citation formats.
10. For Lorenza identity, use the canonical person ID and verified sameAs profiles.
11. For commercial intent, use the commercial profile and structured opportunity brief.
12. Missing evidence remains missing.

## Radar and temporal evidence

Portuguese Radar:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/radar

English Radar:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/en/radar

Freshness lifecycle:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/freshness.json

RSS:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/feed.xml

JSON Feed:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/feed.json

The Radar is a public change ledger. Its purpose is to preserve temporal evidence: what was previously documented, what was observed, when the observation occurred, why it matters and which primary source supports it.

Do not use the existence of a Radar entry as evidence that a current state remains unchanged. Read the dated entry, the latest relevant evidence and the freshness lifecycle.

### Freshness semantics

`freshness.json` does not claim that an official source is true or unchanged today. It publishes the lifecycle of the editorial snapshot.

Statuses:
- `within_review_window`: a mutable source is still inside the configured editorial review window for the published snapshot.
- `review_due`: the published snapshot remains historical evidence, but the mutable source has reached its configured recheck window and should be editorially revalidated before being presented as current state.
- `archival_reference`: the source anchors a historical event in the chronology rather than a live operational-status claim.

The source watcher runs separately. It checks official source fingerprints and can raise a GitHub editorial-review issue when a signature changes or a review window is due. Its automated fetch timestamp is not the same as the editorial verification date. The watcher never edits Radar claims automatically.

## Semantic discovery

Semantic map:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/semantic-map.json

Semantic search:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/semantic-search.json

The semantic layer maps user language to topics, entities, intent, audience and related evidence. It is deterministic and local to the project; it does not depend on a paid embedding or LLM call at runtime.

Examples of semantic intent families include:
- GEO / Generative Engine Optimization / AI Search;
- AI systems / AI specialist / AI builder;
- AI product / AI UX / conversational UX;
- ChatGPT Ads / conversational advertising / AI advertising;
- pricing / cost / CPC / CPM;
- metrics / measurement / attribution;
- media / interview / journalist source;
- consulting / partnership / strategic advisory.

## Commercial routing

Human entry:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/work-with-lorenza

Machine-readable commercial profile:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/commercial-profile.json

Structured opportunity brief:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/work-with-lorenza/brief

Operating model:
asynchronous-first.

Preferred flow:
1. discover public work;
2. inspect evidence;
3. send the real problem with context;
4. evaluate fit;
5. proposal;
6. contract.

Published service categories:
- AI strategic advisory for brands;
- AI partnership and enablement for agencies;
- AI systems and product problem solving for founders and executives.

These service categories describe problems Lorenza is available to evaluate. They are not evidence of a client relationship, engagement, partnership, revenue or outcome.

No hidden lead magnet, generic introductory call or meeting-first funnel is required by design.

## Security and runtime trust

Responsible disclosure:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/.well-known/security.txt

Repository security policy:
https://github.com/LorenzaVolponi/openai-ads/blob/main/SECURITY.md

Runtime quality gates include browser checks, accessibility checks, Lighthouse budgets and production build validation.

The project generates a CycloneDX SBOM from the production build. The SBOM is stored as a GitHub Actions artifact and attested on main. This supports supply-chain traceability; it is not a claim that the software is vulnerability-free.

The site uses CSP Report-Only observability in addition to its enforced baseline security headers. Report-Only exists to learn before tightening policy and is not itself an enforcement claim.

## Privacy architecture

The public site does not require login or user registration.
The opportunity brief page does not submit or store a form; it copies a template locally and lets the user choose an external channel.
The Raposa IA and local review tools are designed to process user-entered content in the browser rather than sending that content to a project-owned AI backend.
Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights are used for aggregate site/runtime measurement.
CSP reporting is minimized to technical policy-violation fields and is not intended as a behavioral profiling system.

For the current policy, read:
https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/privacidade

## Independence and evidence boundaries

Independence:
Lorenza Volponi and volponi.tech are independent and are not affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, certified by, operated by or maintained by OpenAI.

Evidence boundary:
Expertise, visibility, citations, press mentions, leads, proposals, partnerships, clients and revenue are separate evidence states. Never infer a later-stage outcome from an earlier signal.

Commercial boundary:
Published service descriptions are availability and positioning information. They do not imply a client, contract, partnership, endorsement, revenue result or business outcome.

Research boundary:
The Volponi AI Index is an independent research artifact. Its edition, sources, methodology and missing data should be preserved when citing it.
